messages:
Ana (Growth): Quick flag — several inbound leads are stuck at enrichment and not routing. Handoff SLA dashboard shows repeated 10+ minute breaches this morning.

Mike P - RevOps: I saw the same. Enrichment API returned 502s and HS workflows paused around 08:30-09:10 UTC.

Sylvie - Marketing Ops: Can you drop a lead id so I can inspect the workflow run?

Ana (Growth): Lead id 00f7b3c1. HubSpot timeline shows 'workflow paused' and retry attempts.

HubSpotBot: Automated note — Workflow inbound-enrich-2026 failed for contact 00f7b3c1: enrichment API returned 502. Retry scheduled (attempt 1).

Cory (Sales AE): Please avoid stomping on a rep if they already claimed a lead in SFDC. We need owner preservation.

Mike P - RevOps: Short-term mitigations I propose:
1) Add a TTL fallback at 10–12 minutes: if enrichment still pending, move to inbound-rr-ops queue and tag 'enrichment_timeout'.
2) Only trigger fallback when hs_owner_id AND sfdc_owner_id are null.
3) Record original_owner into property 'original_owner_backup' before any reassignment.

Sylvie - Marketing Ops: Draft HS condition to add to the workflow:

```
if contact.enrichment_status == 'pending' and minutes_since(contact.createdate) > 12:
  if is_blank(contact.hs_owner) and is_blank(contact.sfdc_owner):
    contact.original_owner_backup = contact.hs_owner or contact.sfdc_owner
    set contact.owner = round_robin('inbound-rr-ops')
    set contact.properties.fallback_reason = 'enrichment_timeout'
    add_timeline_note('Fallback due to enrichment timeout; original_owner: ' + contact.original_owner_backup)
    notify('#revops-inbound', 'Fallback applied for ' + contact.id)
```

Cory (Sales AE): That note format works — please include timestamp and error tag so we can filter in SF views.

Ana (Growth): Add metric to monitor: percent of inbound leads hitting TTL per hour. If TTL_rate > 4% for 1h, page RevOps. Marketing wants visibility in the handoff dashboard.

Mike P - RevOps: Will add Datadog metric 'marketing.inbound.enrichment_timeout_rate' and an alert: threshold 4% sustained over 1h -> PagerDuty REVOPS-INBOUND. Also creating a Grafana panel for dash.

Sylvie - Marketing Ops: Quick SQL to quantify backlog I ran:

```
SELECT count(*) FROM hubspot_contacts
WHERE enrichment_status = 'pending'
  AND created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';
```

Ana (Growth): Current backlog: 48 pending in the last 24h, 29 created in last 3h. Not catastrophic but bursts cause SLA breaches.

Mike P - RevOps: Rollout plan: staging patch + 20m smoke test -> if green, prod rollout. I'll timestamp deployments here. Also will add a manual dashboard control to force fallback for any stuck contact while we monitor.

HubSpotBot: Workflow inbound-enrich-2026 updated by Mike P - RevOps. TTL fallback rule added.

Sylvie - Marketing Ops: I'll update the inbound playbook and the Sales playbook section about the 'enrichment_timeout' tag and owner restore steps (EOD).

Cory (Sales AE): Please provide the SF note snippet to paste into playbook, e.g. 'Fallback applied: enrichment_timeout @2026-03-21T09:05Z. Original owner: <prop>'.

Mike P - RevOps: Will post the exact note template and add a quick link to the HubSpot timeline. Also creating a one-click revert in the Ops dashboard to restore original_owner_backup if needed.

Ana (Growth): Action items recap:
- Mike: push staging + prod workflow changes, add metric + alert, create manual fallback control (ETA 45m)
- Sylvie: update playbooks + docs for AEs with note templates (ETA EOD)
- Cory: validate SF filter and confirm note template (ETA 2h)

Mike P - RevOps: ack — will update this thread with staging/prod timestamps and initial alert thresholds. :rocket:

Ana (Growth): Thanks — if TTL_rate spikes after rollout we escalate to incident and pause auto-fallback until enrichment retry behavior is fixed.
